model_output.verdict: A store manager with a clear progression and results across sales, staffing, customer satisfaction and shrink.
write_up: Your resume is strong! It shows your progression at Carolina Home & Garden and connects store results to decisions you made, from the garden center layout to weekly schedules. A recruiter can see both how big your current job is and what changed under your management.

The turnover line is a great model: it gives the before and after, then names the scheduling change. Your headline mentions two store turnarounds, but the results underneath are concentrated in the current role, so the second turnaround is less clear.

Add what changed at the other store, then give the earlier department supervisor role a little more detail. Your resume isn't likely to be the reason you don't get a callback; how competitive the store manager job is will matter too.

cards.line: Retail store manager who has turned around two underperforming stores in a 60-store regional chain.
